source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk TRUE, or action change in context sandbox; critical cases require deny. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context sandbox returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90. Trusted means role guest or admin, except for action change; a trusted export prefers allow at priority 80. Action inspect in context sandbox prefers deny at priority 70. Role admin or context external prefers review at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid review. All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means risk TRUE, or action change in context sandbox; critical cases require deny.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context sandbox returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90.
Trusted means role guest or admin, except for action change; a trusted export prefers allow at priority 80.
Action inspect in context sandbox prefers deny at priority 70.
Role admin or context external prefers review at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or ((event.action == change) and (event.context == sandbox))

predicate Trusted(event):
    ((event.role == guest) or (event.role == admin)) and (event.action != change)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == external)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedExport:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == export)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80

rule InspectSandbox:
    when (event.action == inspect) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule AdminOrExternal:
    when (event.role == admin) or (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule TrustedForbidReview:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = review

rule OtherRoles:
    when event.role in {guest, admin, operator}
    then prefer label = allow priority 1
